accountant_is_configured.meaning: the Vault has an Accountant configured

active_registration_exists_for_target_sl.meaning: an active registration exists for the target BLP slot

slot_is_activated_strict_read.meaning: the registered slot is an activated strict-read slot that Accountant backing reads can dereference
slot_is_activated_strict_read.checkpoint: before Accountant backing reads dereference the slot

accounting_reads_and_settlement_succeed.meaning: Accountant backing/surplus reads and settlement complete without reverting
accounting_reads_and_settlement_succeed.checkpoint: during Accountant backing/surplus reads and settlement

assumptions: The operator's call to supplyToBlp is the checked action; the report does not establish caller authorization, so no permissionless-caller claim is made.
The inactive-slot outcome is conditional and potential, not established as observed.

unresolved.description: Report does not specify the exact suppliedBalance read or its expected value for the postcondition check, so the strict-read dereference relation is represented only by a grounded Boolean.
Timing of HyperCore activation (synchronous vs asynchronous) relative to the supplyToBlp call is not established by the report.

limitations: The potential/conditional status of the revert impact is preserved via a Boolean success symbol rather than an unconditional effect.
Only the selected impact accounting_reads_and_settlement_revert is formalized; other impacts are handled separately.
